description: Defines the AddressTrackerLinux class responsible for tracking network interface addresses and online links on Linux systems using rtnetlink. It provides mechanisms for initialization, callbacks on address/link changes, and querying network state, primarily used by NetworkChangeNotifier.

classes.name: AddressTrackerLinux
classes.description: Manages tracking of network interface addresses and online links on Linux, providing callbacks and querying capabilities for network state changes.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Default constructor for non-tracking mode, takes a snapshot of current system configuration.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Constructor for tracking mode, sets callbacks for address, link, and tunnel changes, and specifies ignored interfaces and optional blocking thread runner.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Starts watching system configuration for changes in tracking mode.

methods.name: InitWithFdForTesting
methods.description: Initializes with a provided file descriptor for testing.

methods.name: GetAddressMap
methods.description: Returns current address map; callable on any thread.

methods.name: GetOnlineLinks
methods.description: Returns set of online interface indices; callable on any thread.

methods.name: GetInitialDataAndStartRecordingDiffs
methods.description: Returns current address map and online links, and starts recording diffs; callable on any thread.

methods.name: SetDiffCallback
methods.description: Sets callback to be invoked on address/link changes in tracking mode.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns current network connection type; blocks until Init completes.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Returns interface name given index, similar to if_indextoname.

methods.name: IsTunnelInterfaceName
methods.description: Checks if interface name refers to a tunnel.
